fusions.name: Transfixing Glare
fusions.desc: Fixes one enemy up to 9 tiles away with your gaze, dealing 11 damage and stunning it for 1.2 seconds. It has 50% more critical chance against an enemy that has not been wounded yet.

fusions.name: Unblinking Stare
fusions.desc: You fix a cone 4 tiles ahead with your gaze, dealing 3 damage with a 35% chance to leave each enemy [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Lidless Vigil
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.4 times as far.

fusions.name: Ripple Tally
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: a blow strikes it for 34% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
